_readme: Template every business's ElevenLabs agent is built from (M5). Bump template_version when you change anything here; syncAgent then updates every agent and its tools. Field names follow the ElevenLabs Agents API (checked against the official elevenlabs-js SDK). Values come from config/agent_settings.md.
llm_note: No temperature: current Claude models reject non-default sampling values. agent_settings.md suggests 0.3 for other LLMs; set temperature here if you switch to one.

caller_intent.description: What the caller wanted: book, change, cancel, question, message, other.

booking_made.description: True if a booking was created, moved or cancelled successfully.

language.description: Language of the call: fa or en.

callback_needed.description: True if the caller expects a call back from the business.

evaluation_criteria.name: Goal met
evaluation_criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: Was the purpose of the call achieved (booking, answer, message taken or transfer)?

transfer_condition: The caller insists on speaking to a person, is upset after one attempt to help, or it is urgent for the business. Only during the transfer hours in the system prompt.
